decision.observed_event: You declare: "I rage and swing my greataxe at the dealer. I rolled 18 to hit, 11 slashing damage."

appraisal.label: concern
appraisal.cause: An attack the table cannot resolve.

improv_read.player_bid: Brakka rages and attacks the dealer, reporting a hit and damage.
improv_read.connection: The attack would trigger the retreat rule, but the table recorded only his words, so no result can be narrated.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit refuses to invent a combat result the table did not resolve and asks plainly.

public_brief.objective: Rule plainly that the attack cannot be resolved here.
public_brief.tactic: State the limit once and ask for the next action.
public_brief.player_opening: He can hold or restate the attack.
public_brief.reply_to: I rage and swing my greataxe at the dealer.
public_brief.kit_focus: Frame the ruling plainly and briefly, with no narrated outcome for the swing.
public_brief.mirror: steady energy, tight, no humor: state the limit and stop

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.text: That swing starts a fight, and this table cannot run fights yet, so nothing lands. Do you still want to attack, or hold the axe?
